# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** 17 years old by the end of Volume 2  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c26 P25](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0025), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c3 P22](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0022)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Rank:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c26 P25](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0025), [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell is a tall, slim girl with pale, freckled skin and vivid gray eyes that shift in shade and light. She has thick, naturally wavy red hair, which she wore cropped short for a period after a dyeing mishap, though it later grew into soft, dark auburn ringlets bound with a black velvet ribbon. Her expressive face features a sharp chin, aWIDE mouth, and a neat, pretty nose.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c15 P14](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0014), [v1 c27 P35](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0035), [v1 c28 P6](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0006), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c3 P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036)_

## Personality

Nell is an intensely imaginative, romantic, and loquacious girl with a passionate, fiery temper that flares up quickly when her looks or red hair are insulted. Deeply sensitive to beauty and affection, she feels emotions acutely, plunging into despair over disappointments and soaring into ecstasy over simple joys. She possesses a lively wit, a dramatic flair, and an earnest desire to be good, though her impulsive nature and vivid daydreams often lead her into unexpected blunders and scrapes. Despite her sensitivity, she is courageous, forgiving, and intensely loyal to her friends and foster family.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P26](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0026), [v1 c2 P51](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0051), [v1 c5 P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 c5 P5](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0005), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P41](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0041), [v1 c10 P32](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0032), [v1 c13 P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019), [v1 c15 P94](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0094)_

## History

Brought to Brierley by mistake instead of a boy, Nell quickly won over Obed Abernethy and eventually his sister Thirza, who decided to keep her at Grey Shutters. She settled into the community, naming local landmarks with imaginative titles, making a bosom friend in Isolde Pembroke, and entering Brierley School. Her early years at Grey Shutters were marked by energetic scrapes, including an outburst at neighbor Agatha Sowerby over her red hair, accidentally getting Isolde drunk on homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, and confessing to stealing a brooch she had merely misplaced. At school, she engaged in a fierce academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow, which escalated into a slate-smashing incident after he mocked her hair. She subsequently left school briefly in protest of the teacher's punishment, but returned and successfully advanced to the higher grades. Nell excelled academically and socially, organizing a story club and performing in local concerts. When Obed Abernethy died suddenly following the failure of the Abbey Bank, Nell gave up an opportunity to attend college immediately and took up teaching at Brierley School to support Thirza and keep Grey Shutters. During her time teaching, she saved the life of little Posy Fay Pembroke during an attack of croup, helped establish the Brierley Village Improvement Society, and accidentally dyed her hair green before cutting it short. Later, after winning the Avery Scholarship at Regent's Academy in Portmaris, she earned her First Class teacher's license and pursued an Arts degree at Wexcombe College alongside friends Honora Hollis, Mabel Colby, and Cressida Lindsay, residing at Tabby's Place. After resolving her lingering grudges with Hugh Carrow, Nell realized her true love for him, rejected a marriage proposal from Cyril Lisle, and eventually accepted Hugh's proposal in Dinah Wren's old garden. She gave up her scholarship to stay at Grey Shutters when Thirza's eyesight began to fail, taking the local teaching position in Brierley after Hugh selflessly yielded it to her.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c14 P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), [v1 c14 P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c18 P33](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0033), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c27 P20](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0020), [v1 c36 P8](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0008), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c9 P11](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0011), [v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020), [v2 c14 P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 c23 P20](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0020)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia, to high school teachers Edmund and Bertha Harcourt, both of whom died of fever when she was three months old  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised in poverty by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, helping care for the Thomas children  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived for over two years with Mrs. Rudge in an isolated clearing, taking care of three consecutive sets of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Spent four months in the Marden orphan asylum before being brought to St. Brendan's Island by Mrs. Alexander Tranter  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Taken in by Obed and Thirza Abernethy of Grey Shutters due to a mix-up when they had requested a boy  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)</sub>

## Quotes

> Gracious heavenly Father, I thank Thee for the Petal Road of Delight and the Lake of Glassy Waters and Bonny and the Frost Maiden.  <sub>[v1 c7 P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021)</sub>

> My hatred for you is absolute. My hatred for you—my hatred for you—my hatred for you—  <sub>[v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016)</sub>

> Going back to a place I know is truly home feels wonderful.  <sub>[v1 c10 P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)</sub>

> There are so many distinct Annes. That might explain why I cause so much trouble, or so I occasionally believe. Life would be far simpler if I were merely the single Nell, yet it would not be nearly as interesting.  <sub>[v1 c20 P4](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0004)</sub>

> I am not altered at all—not in truth. I have merely been trimmed back and grown new limbs. The genuine me—deep inside—remains unaltered.  <sub>[v1 c34 P6](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0006)</sub>
